layered.status: Exploratory diagnostic on the same 28 development cases.
layered.conclusion: A fixed finite modal order has a response-error floor. Grid refinement alone cannot force this closure error to zero. Growing mode count is one sufficient numerical route, without a claim of learned convergence.
